name: Backup Soldier
source_text: You can activate this card when there are 5 or more Monster Cards in your Graveyard. Select up to 3 Monster Cards with an ATK of 1500 points or less (except Effect Monster Cards) from your Graveyard and add them to your hand.
notes: The condition counts monsters, not all Graveyard cards.
